import pyautogui, time
# ensure terminal is focused by clicking near the prompt area
pyautogui.click(220, 150)
time.sleep(0.2)
# type the command to show the version/features file and press Enter
pyautogui.typewrite('cat ~/Documents/extension_versioning.txt', interval=0.02)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.6)
traj.r: Reflection: The Terminal is open and focused with the shell prompt visible. I'll run cat on ~/Documents/extension_versioning.txt to read the required version/features before generating the extension.
